settings.label: Logo
settings.info: The circular badge. Its own background is #0D1014, which matches the dark theme exactly — do not crop it to a transparent PNG or it will lose that fit.

settings.content: Colours live in assets/styles.css as CSS custom properties, not here. Gold is deliberately split into --gold (ink, darkens in light mode) and --gold-fill (paint, never changes). Read the comment at the top of that file before changing either.
